left.en: Nuna and Theo, ready, set, go!
left.es-MX: Nuna y Theo, en sus marcas... ¡ya!

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Theo crouch at a start line drawn on the grass, ready to run; on the right a cheetah bursts forward out of a crouch across the savanna, in the same starting pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a wide sky band across the top, a band of low trees through the middle, a grass band along the bottom.

left.en: Both run as fast as they can.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Theo run side by side across the grass, arms pumping; on the right an ostrich runs across open plains with long, giant strides, in the same running pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a wide sky band across the top, a distant plains band through the middle, a grass band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Nuna e Theo pulam a corda.
left.en: Nuna and Theo jump over the rope.
left.es-MX: Nuna y Theo saltan la cuerda.

right.pt-BR: O impala pula lá no alto.
right.en: The impala leaps way up high.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Theo leap over a rope lying on the grass, knees up; on the right an impala leaps high over tall grass in the same knees-up jump. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a band of tall grass through the middle, a dry ground band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Nuna e Theo pulam no saco.
left.en: Nuna and Theo hop in sacks.
left.es-MX: Nuna y Theo saltan en costales.

right.pt-BR: O canguru pula de pés juntos.
right.en: The kangaroo hops with its feet together.
right.es-MX: El canguro salta con las patas juntas.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Theo hop forward inside two cloth sacks, feet together; on the right a kangaroo hops forward with both feet together, in the same bouncing pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a band of gum trees through the middle, a dusty ground band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Nuna e Theo levam o ovo na colher.
left.en: Nuna and Theo carry eggs on spoons.
left.es-MX: Nuna y Theo llevan el huevo en cuchara.

right.pt-BR: O pinguim leva o ovo nos pés.
right.en: The penguin carries its egg on its feet.
right.es-MX: El pingüino lleva su huevo en las patas.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Theo walk very carefully, each holding a spoon with an egg on it; on the right an emperor penguin shuffles carefully across the ice with an egg resting on its feet, in the same careful walk. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, an ice ridge band through the middle, a flat ice band along the bottom.

right.pt-BR: A lebre faz zigue-zague mais rápido.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Theo zigzag between little cones on the grass; on the right a hare zigzags across a meadow in the same swerving run. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a hedge band through the middle, a meadow band along the bottom.

On the left Nuna and Theo jog backward across the grass, looking over their shoulders; on the right a crayfish shoots backward through a clear stream with a flick of its tail, in the same backward dash. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a grassy bank band through the middle, a shallow streambed band along the bottom.

right.en: The slug wins, nice and slow.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Theo take tiny, slow steps toward a ribbon finish line, giggling; on the right a slug glides slowly along a leaf and reaches the tip first, in the same slow forward stretch. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a garden plant band through the middle, a grass band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: A capa do Theo voa na corrida.
left.en: Theo's cape flies as he runs.
left.es-MX: La capa de Theo vuela al correr.

right.pt-BR: O lagarto corre de gola aberta.
right.en: The frilled lizard runs on two legs.
right.es-MX: El lagarto de gorguera corre en dos patas.

spreads.scene: On the left Theo runs with his cape flapping behind him while Nuna runs beside him with her arms spread wide; on the right a frilled lizard runs upright on its two back legs with its frill open wide, in the same flying run. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a band of dry bushes through the middle, a sandy ground band along the bottom.

right.en: The wildebeest run by the thousands.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Theo run through a ribbon finish line side by side, holding hands; on the right a big herd of wildebeest runs together across the plains, side by side, in the same running pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a wide sky band across the top, a dust cloud band through the middle, a plains band along the bottom.

right.en: The camel drinks a whole lot.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Theo sit on the grass drinking from big water bottles, heads tipped back; on the right a camel drinks and drinks at a desert pool, in the same thirsty pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a band of sand dunes through the middle, a water pool band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Nuna e Theo cochilam em pé.
left.en: Nuna and Theo nod off standing up.
left.es-MX: Nuna y Theo cabecean de pie.

right.pt-BR: O cavalo cochila em pé mesmo.
right.en: The horse can nap standing up.
right.es-MX: El caballo sí dormita de pie.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna and Theo stand leaning on each other with their eyes closing, very sleepy; on the right a horse sleeps standing up in a field with its eyes closed and head low, in the same sleepy stance. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: an evening sky band across the top, a fence band through the middle, a field band along the bottom.

cover_scene: Nuna and Theo stand side by side, facing forward, with a small cheetah, a small ostrich, and a small impala scattered around them, all looking towards Nuna and Theo, against a background of three horizontal bands.
